translationRepairs: When the imperial army recovered the capital he was due for the extreme penalty; Lin was already over seventy, and Li Sheng pitied his age and memorialized to reduce the sentence to death.
When the imperial army recovered the capital he was due for the extreme penalty; Lin was already over seventy, and Li Sheng pitied his age and memorialized to commute the death sentence.

s0123 ends 表請減死: Li Sheng petitioned to commute the death penalty already implied by 當處極刑. "Reduce the sentence to death" reverses that meaning; "commute the death sentence" matches 減死 and the next unit's refused-execution outcome.
